gold_statement: The app shall calculate the run-out date from the dispensed quantity and expected supply duration of the active prescription.
statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the expected number of days supply per dispense in a medication request.

gold_statement: The app shall notify the patient when the pharmacy has dispensed the medication and it is ready to collect.
statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the intended dispenser for a medication request.

gold_statement: The app shall send a refill reminder 7 days before a medication's supply is expected to run out.
statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the number of refills allowed for a medication request.

gold_statement: The app shall require the patient to confirm they are still taking the medication before a renewal request is sent.
statement: The system shall allow prescribers to specify the time period for which a medication request is authorized.
